text_ref: The worshipers of the Most Gracious are those who tread the earth gently, and when the ignorant speak to them, they only utter peace.

text_1981: In the privacy of the night, they meditate on their Lord, and fall prostrate.
text_1989: In the privacy of the night, they meditate on their Lord, and fall prostrate.
text_ref: In the privacy of the night, they meditate on their Lord, and fall prostrate.

text_1981: And they say, "Our Lord, spare us the agony of Hell; its retribution is horrendous.
text_1989: And they say, “Our Lord, keep the agony of Hell away from us; its retribution is horrendous.
text_ref: And they say, "Our Lord, spare us the agony of Hell; its retribution is horrendous.

text_1981: "It is the worst abode; the worst destiny."
text_1989: “It is the worst abode; the worst destiny.”
text_ref: "It is the worst abode; the worst destiny."

text_1981: When they give, they are neither extravagant, nor stingy; they give in moderation.
text_1989: When they give, they are neither extravagant, nor stingy; they spend in moderation. 0 1790 r
text_ref: When they give, they are neither extravagant, nor stingy; they give in moderation.

text_1981: They never implore beside GOD any other god, nor do they kill any soul—for GOD has made life sacred—except in the course of justice. Nor do they commit adultery. Those who commit these offenses will have to pay.
text_1989: And they never implore besides GOD any other god, nor do they kill any soul—for GOD has made life sacred— 366 except in the course of justice. Nor do they commit adultery. Those who commit these offenses will have to pay.
text_ref: They never implore beside GOD any other god, nor do they kill any soul—for GOD has made life sacred—except in the course of justice. Nor do they commit adultery. Those who commit these offenses will have to pay.

text_1981: Retribution is doubled for them on the Day of Resurrection, and they abide therein humiliated.
text_1989: Retribution is doubled for them on the Day of Resurrection, and they abide therein humiliated.
text_ref: Retribution is doubled for them on the Day of Resurrection, and they abide therein humiliated.

text_1981: Exempted are those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life. GOD transforms their sins into credits. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
text_1989: Exempted are those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life. GOD transforms their sins into credits. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.
text_ref: Exempted are those who repent, believe, and lead a righteous life. GOD transforms their sins into credits. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

text_1981: Those who repent and lead a righteous life, GOD redeems them; a complete redemption.
text_1989: Those who repent and lead a righteous life return to GOD, and He will surely redeem them a complete redemption.
text_ref: Those who repent and lead a righteous life, GOD redeems them; a complete redemption.

subtitle: Additional Traits of the Righteous
text_1981: They do not bear false witness. When they encounter vain talk, they ignore it.
text_1989: And they do not bear false witness. And when they encounter vain talk, they ignore it.
text_ref: They do not bear false witness. When they encounter vain talk, they ignore it.

text_1981: When reminded of their Lord's revelations, they never react to them as if they were deaf and blind.
text_1989: When reminded of their Lord’s revelations, they never react to them as if they were deaf and blind.
text_ref: When reminded of their Lord's revelations, they never react to them as if they were deaf and blind.

text_1981: And they say, "Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us, and keep us in the forefront of the righteous."
text_1989: And they say, “Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us, and keep us in the forefront of the righteous.”
text_ref: And they say, "Our Lord, let our spouses and children be a source of joy for us, and keep us in the forefront of the righteous."

text_1981: These are the ones who attain Paradise in return for their steadfastness; they are received therein with joyous greetings and peace.
text_1989: These are the ones who attain fastness; they are received therein with joyous greetings and peace.
text_ref: These are the ones who attain Paradise in return for their steadfastness; they are received therein with joyous greetings and peace.

text_1981: Eternally they abide therein; what a beautiful destiny; what a beautiful abode.
text_1989: Eternally they abide therein; what a beautiful destiny; what a beautiful abode.
text_ref: Eternally they abide therein; what a beautiful destiny; what a beautiful abode.

text_1981: Say, "You attain value at my Lord only through your worship. But if you disbelieve, you incur the inevitable consequences."
text_1989: Say, “You attain value at my Lord only through your worship. But if you disbelieve, you incur the inevitable consequences.”
text_ref: Say, "You attain value at my Lord only through your worship. But if you disbelieve, you incur the inevitable consequences."
